'''Sosal''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Saheelindeeli]] leader of [[Maslovar]]'s [[Alien/Legends|alien]] underground, on [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. She used her technical skills to wreak havoc on the elite of Maslovar.
